purpose: Guide a focused human review of the stub-backed shell, workspace, retail-business query, detail, and report navigation surfaces exposed at /platform/stub.

reviewModeDefinitions.manual-only: Human observation is required because automation does not currently prove the visible or interaction-specific result.
reviewModeDefinitions.shared-with-automation: Run the manual check in the hosted stub experience, but treat related semantics already covered by automated tests as a guardrail rather than a new defect category.
reviewModeDefinitions.defer-if-out-of-scope: Record the observation, then defer it to the named downstream owner instead of treating it as an early-UAT defect.

severityScale.High: Blocks navigation or a core interaction inside the frozen stub-backed review scope.
severityScale.Medium: Incorrect but still usable layout, focus, labeling, or navigation behavior.
severityScale.Low: Minor cosmetic or non-blocking presentation issue.

deferRules.observationType: Business-rule correctness, backend truth, or real data validation
Multi-organization identity, role scoping, or authorization behavior
Deep organization-model behavior beyond the accepted distributor framing
Mutation workflows or representative end-to-end behavior

items.title: Stub route loads the hosted shell review surface
steps: Launch the web app with the Stub UAT profile or the CLI command listed above.
Open /platform/stub if the browser does not navigate there automatically.
Wait for the shell to finish rendering.
expectedSignals: The informational stub-mode alert renders above the shell rather than replacing it.
The shell title shows Distributor Demo.
The page does not fall back to the disabled-mode or missing-registration warning alerts.
items.humanObservationFocus: Integrated hosted rendering, visual stability, and obvious shell regressions.

items.title: Skip link reaches the main workspace cleanly
steps: Press Tab immediately after the page loads.
Activate the Skip to main content link with Enter.
expectedSignals: Focus becomes visible on the skip link before activation.
After activation, focus lands inside the main workspace rather than staying trapped in shell chrome.
items.humanObservationFocus: Visible focus treatment and the lived keyboard feel of the shell frame.

items.title: Primary navigation and workspace tabs keep an obvious focus path
steps: Tab through the main navigation affordances, any menu trigger, and the workspace tab strip.
Use Shift+Tab where needed to confirm the reverse path is still understandable.
expectedSignals: Visible focus remains obvious on each interactive shell element.
Focus order feels predictable and does not jump unexpectedly between navigation and workspace regions.
items.humanObservationFocus: Visible focus styling, perceived tab order, and shell discoverability.

items.title: Retail-business search page layout is understandable before searching
steps: Open the Retail Businesses page from the shell navigation.
Review the page header, filter inputs, Search button, and empty-or-initial grid area before running a search.
expectedSignals: The page title reads Stub Retail Businesses.
Name and City filters are clearly labeled.
The Search action is easy to find and the page layout does not crowd the filter and grid regions.
items.humanObservationFocus: Label clarity, spacing, alignment, and first-impression usability.

items.title: Retail-business search results render through the hosted stub path
steps: On the Stub Retail Businesses page, click Search without adding filters.
Review the resulting grid and toolbar status text.
expectedSignals: The grid renders retail-business rows from the stub dataset without error banners.
The Retail Business, City, and Tier columns remain readable.
The hosted page still feels stable when results load.
items.humanObservationFocus: Hosted query-page rendering quality rather than business-data correctness.

items.title: Recent retail-business navigation opens a detail tab in the workspace
steps: Open the Retail Businesses navigation group.
Choose a Recent Retail Businesses entry such as Harbor Roast Cafe Group.
Observe the new workspace tab and its content.
expectedSignals: A detail tab opens inside the shell workspace instead of replacing the whole page.
The detail surface clearly identifies the selected record key.
The detail tab reads as part of the same hosted workspace flow.
items.humanObservationFocus: Shell-to-workspace navigation feel and clarity of the detail target.

items.title: Report navigation opens the stub retail-business summary report
steps: Open the report menu from the shell.
Choose Stub Retail Business Summary.
Wait for the report page to finish loading.
expectedSignals: A report tab opens in the workspace.
The hosted report renders the Stub Retail Business Summary content without overlapping chrome or error output.
The toolbar and report body are both reachable after load.
items.humanObservationFocus: Hosted report-page composition, readability, and shell integration.

items.title: Workspace tab switching stays understandable across search, detail, and report pages
steps: Open the search, detail, and report surfaces so at least three workspace tabs are present.
Switch between the open tabs with the pointer and, where supported, keyboard focus.
expectedSignals: The selected tab is visually obvious.
Switching tabs does not leave the workspace in a confusing or partially rendered state.
Open surfaces remain easy to distinguish from one another.
items.humanObservationFocus: Workspace orientation, tab affordance clarity, and interaction smoothness.

items.title: Report toolbar remains keyboard reachable after the report loads
steps: Open Stub Retail Business Summary.
Tab through the report toolbar controls after the report is visible.
expectedSignals: Toolbar controls can be reached in a logical keyboard order.
Visible focus remains obvious on report toolbar controls.
The keyboard path does not skip unexpectedly over the report actions.
items.humanObservationFocus: Visible focus and real browser keyboard traversal.

items.title: Rendered report content stays readable and visually ordered
steps: With Stub Retail Business Summary open, review the rendered report body from top to bottom.
If zoom controls are available, change zoom once and review the page again.
expectedSignals: The report title and detail rows remain readable in sequence.
Changing zoom does not make the structured content feel unusable.
No obvious overlap or clipping appears between the report body and surrounding shell content.
items.humanObservationFocus: Legibility, layout confidence, and overall visual comprehension.
